jobs.program: Summer Clerkship 2027/28 recruitment round (NSW Graduate and Clerkship Recruitment Program)
jobs.notes: The Law Society's live clerkship page lists Wednesday 9 June as the 2027-round opening date for summer clerkship applications (offers from Thursday 9 September), but the application closing date was not confirmed on the page, so 'closes' is null; applications are generally for penultimate-year students and all participating NSW firms must follow these dates.
